project_info.name: DutchBay Hybrid Wind+Solar
project_info.location: Dutch Bay, Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, Sri Lanka

created_by: M3 hybrid (canonical wind bankable export + declared solar P50)
notes: Combined bankable AEP for the 209.6 MW hybrid = wind 473.8 GWh (15 x IEA-10MW-198 via wind_resource.bankable_aep; ERA5-fitted Weibull A=8.199/k=2.665; PyWake 7.28% wake; 14.48% total losses) + solar 87.6 GWh (50 MW fixed-tilt, Puttalam GHI, declared P50). Net CF 0.305842 over 209.6 MW nameplate reconciles with capacity_mw*capacity_factor (the engine bills revenue off that). The solar P50 is a declared config value pending the pvlib producer (multi-tech build item 3); the per-tech split drives the lender reporting (generation.technologies).
